title: Stories: beginning, middle and end
examples: Teacher, where do I find the problem in a story?
Can you give me an example of a character?
What is the end part of a story?

explain.say: A story has three parts. They are the beginning, the middle and the end.
The beginning tells you who the story is about. You meet the characters.

items: Characters are the people or animals.
They are who the story follows.
We meet them at the start.

explain.say: In the middle, a problem happens. Something goes wrong.
At the end, the problem gets fixed. The story finishes.
Here is a story. A little bear wants honey. The honey is too high to reach.

draw.text: Bear wants honey, but cannot reach it

explain.say: Playing has a beginning, middle and end too. First, you are getting ready. Then you are playing. Last, you tidy away.

draw.text: Playing a game: start, action, stop

faq.q: What is a character in a story?
faq.a: A character is any person or animal that appears in the story. They are the ones who do the actions.
asks: Who are the people in the book?

faq.q: Where does the problem happen in a story?
faq.a: The problem usually happens in the middle part of the story. This is what makes the story exciting to read.
asks: When does the story get difficult?

faq.q: Does the end always fix the problem?
faq.a: Most stories do fix the problem by the end. This is called the resolution, and it makes the story feel complete.

faq.q: Can a story have a problem in the beginning?
faq.a: Sometimes. A small problem can start early. The big problem is usually in the middle.
asks: Can the problem start right away?

faq.q: What is the difference between the middle and the end?
faq.a: In the middle, the problem happens. At the end, the problem is fixed and things are calm again.

facts: Stories usually have a beginning, middle, and end.
Characters are the people or animals in the story.
The problem is the main challenge in the story's middle.
The end part shows how the problem is solved.

quiz.say: Amira wakes up and gets out of bed. Which part of the story is this?
quiz.why: Waking up is how the story starts. That is the beginning.

wrong.1: The middle is where the problem happens.
wrong.2: The end is where the problem gets fixed.

quiz.say: The puppy finds its family at last. Which part of the story is this?
quiz.why: Finding the family fixes the problem. That happens at the end.

wrong.0: The beginning is where you meet the puppy.
wrong.1: The middle is where the puppy gets lost.

quiz.say: The kitten is lost. It looks for its home. Which part of the story is this?
quiz.why: Getting lost is the problem. The problem happens in the middle.

wrong.0: The beginning is where you meet the kitten.
wrong.2: The end is where the kitten gets home.
